entities.summary: Trento Cathedral is the main church in the city of Trento. It serves as the cathedral of the Archdiocese of Trento and was elevated to the rank of minor basilica by Pope Pius X on 18 March 1913. It was also designated an Italian national monument by royal decree in 1940.
